text.tspan: deu um pequeno suspiro e sorriu.
Pipoca ainda soluçava baixinho no canto…
Até que Lila se aproximou devagar, sem dizer nada...
A young Tyrannosaurus Rex, just a toddler, rendered in a charming watercolor style (aquarelle painting
method). His primary color is a sunny yellow, the kind that makes you smile. He's been drawn with a slimmer,
more elongated body than you might typically imagine for a T-Rex, emphasizing his youthfulness. This makes
him appear a little taller and less bulky, enhancing his cute and approachable demeanor. His head is large and
round with big, endearing eyes that are a deep, captivating blue, complete with bright white highlights that
make them sparkle. A gentle smile curves his mouth, revealing tiny, harmless teeth. His small arms,
characteristic of a T-Rex, are held slightly away from his body, and his sturdy legs end in rounded, three-clawed
feet. A row of soft, rounded spikes runs down his back and along his tail, painted in slightly muted shades of
yellow and orange, adding to his gentle appearance. Present the young Tyrannosaurus Rex sitting in the corner
of the room. A dinosaur friend comes near him and give him a drawing he made. He looks up to his colleague
and feels cheerful and relief. The scene gets brighter and colors stars to appear back in his life. The watercolor
technique gives him a soft, slightly textured look, as if the paint has just dried on the page, perfect for a sweet
